lessons.title: Five Senses and Sense Organs
lessons.objective: Identify the five senses and connect each sense with the organ that supports it.

lessons.title: Hearing and Making Sounds
lessons.objective: Identify sound sources and distinguish loudness from pitch and safe listening.

lessons.title: Seeing the World and Colour
lessons.objective: Describe how eyes and light support sight and recognise simple colour relationships.

lessons.title: Touch and Texture
lessons.objective: Use touch vocabulary to compare familiar safe surfaces and recognise unsafe contact.

lessons.title: Taste and Smell Safely
lessons.objective: Distinguish taste from smell and choose safe actions around unfamiliar foods and substances.

activities.prompt: Which sense helps you notice a ringing bell?

optionRationales.a: Sight helps you notice the bell's appearance, not its sound.
optionRationales.b: Hearing detects the bell's sound.
optionRationales.c: Taste is not used to hear sounds.

activities.feedbackCorrect: Well done! You chose the best answer.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: Nice try. Think about what you have learned, then try again.

activities.prompt: Which statement about pitch and loudness is correct?

options.text: A sound can be high-pitched and quiet

optionRationales.a: Pitch describes how high or low a sound is; loudness describes how strong it seems.
optionRationales.b: A high-pitched sound can be quiet or loud.
optionRationales.c: Pitch and loudness describe different features of sound.

activities.feedbackCorrect: Well done! You chose the best answer.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: Nice try. Think about what you have learned, then try again.

activities.prompt: Which action protects your eyes when the Sun is bright?

optionRationales.b: Looking directly at the Sun can seriously harm the eyes.
optionRationales.c: A magnifying glass makes looking at the Sun even more dangerous.

activities.safetyNote: Never ask a child to look directly at the Sun.
activities.feedbackCorrect: Well done! You chose the best answer.

activities.prompt: Dust gets near your eye. What should you do?

optionRationales.c: Ignoring a possible reaction is unsafe.
